# External figure credits

Generated by `scripts/fetch_external_figures.py`. Do not edit by hand -- re-run
the script instead, so the credits stay tied to the source. Wikimedia entries are
pulled live from the Commons API; entries marked *declared in manifest* have their
author and licence transcribed from the source article and verified against it.
